title: Candle Confirmation Strategy (synthetic test article)
text:
Introduction. This article presents the Candle Confirmation strategy for EURUSD on the H1 timeframe. The author reports a win rate of 97 percent in the strategy tester.
Signal definition. At the opening moment of the current H1 candle the Expert Advisor decides the direction using the final close of that very same candle, Close[0] as it will be once the candle has completed, together with the high of the following candle. A buy order is placed at the open price of the current candle when its final close is above its open and the high of the next candle exceeds the current high by 10 points. A sell order is placed at the open price of the current candle when its final close is below its open and the low of the next candle is lower than the current low by 10 points.
Implementation. In the backtest script the arrays are shifted with close.shift(0) and high.shift(-1), and the entry price is open of the same row. The condition is evaluated over the whole history at once.
Exit. The position is closed at the close of the next candle. No stop loss is used.
Parameters. Breakout margin 10 points, lot 0.1, symbol EURUSD, timeframe H1.
Test results. Over 2020-2023 the backtest produced 1450 trades, profit factor 14.2 and maximum drawdown 1.1 percent. The author concludes that candle confirmation is a very reliable signal and recommends running it live.
